objective: count one causally unified bridge that admits fresh major-shock reversals and ordinary weak-turn repairs only after fast ownership survives into a slope cross, while preserving existing Stage112 positions

origin_law.major_shock_reversal: Stage119 fixed 5x flush, 2x flush range, opposite 12x reversal, 2x reversal range, dual-book price/velocity/acceleration direction; volume never supplies direction
origin_law.ordinary_velocity_front: all five 30/60/120/240/480m slopes share incumbent sign and the 30m velocity first flips opposite that incumbent
origin_law.subshock: excluded because the historical tape has no seconds-order identity
origin_law.one_owner: both origins feed one phase-front state and one eventual lifecycle; they are not separate strategies

epoch_law.major_reset: every fresh major-shock reversal closes any stale untraded front as SUPERSEDED_BY_MAJOR_SHOCK and starts a new epoch
epoch_law.ordinary_start: ordinary origin may start only while no live front exists
epoch_law.fast_failure_release: loss of new-direction 30m velocity before the first 30m slope cross terminates the untraded front immediately
epoch_law.recoil_failure_release: after the fast slope cross, loss of the fast slope before velocity reacquisition terminates the front
epoch_law.contract_gap_raw_boundaries: contract reset, genuine open-session gap, and exact V18 raw turn remain terminals

entry_morphology.fast_ownership: 30m velocity must remain in the origin direction until the 30m slope first crosses
entry_morphology.propagation: at entry the declared velocity breadth and slope breadth must be present on a completed 5m state
entry_morphology.persistence: the complete entry predicate must survive one or two consecutive completed 5m states
entry_morphology.extreme_retention: major-shock epochs must not reclaim the opposite CL or MCL reversal extreme before entry
diagnostics_only: ordered first velocity and slope arrival times

position_arbitration_for_future_economic.flat: a qualifying front may schedule one next-open entry
position_arbitration_for_future_economic.same_direction_stage112: attach evidence only; never duplicate or reset cost basis
position_arbitration_for_future_economic.opposite_stage112_ordinary_or_minute_pro: abstain; historical proxy authority may not interrupt an existing Stage112 owner
position_arbitration_for_future_economic.opposite_stage112_authentic_seconds_majo: future live handoff may occur only after Stage114 AUTHORITY_BOUND plus the same completed-5m propagation
position_arbitration_for_future_economic.risk: raw-loss cap, weekly flat, roll, data gap, and opposite authentic authority remain unconditional

count_gate.cadence_capacity: tradeable candidate count must be sufficient in principle to lift Stage112 above 200 trades per year after overlap

known_incident.role: design specimen only outside historical count tape
known_incident.required: fresh Stage114 UP authority at 2026-08-06T05:30:38Z resets the failed 03:50 ordinary front and becomes tradeable by the 05:35 or 05:45 completed propagation state
known_incident.negative_control: the 01:25 UP impulse has no major-shock epoch and cannot inherit the later 05:30 authority
